Evidence caveats

  • 17,598 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.
  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.
  • Matchup playbooks describe what the field policy repeatedly selected against each opponent. They do not claim the most-used bring or lead causally outperforms alternatives.
  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.
  • Legacy exact context: 17,598 games at 69.1%; excluded from the headline and evidence grade.

Evidence caveats

  • KO, damage, opener, and fast-matchup findings come from the approximate simulator. The carried-versus-contributing table is artifact-scoped current Showdown evidence when available.
  • Matchup playbooks describe what the field policy repeatedly selected against each opponent. They do not claim the most-used bring or lead causally outperforms alternatives.
  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.

Evidence caveats

  • 462 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.
  • Legacy exact context: 462 games at 63.0%; excluded from the headline and evidence grade.
